narratives.Description: Deliver Module 10 and a guarded disposable Node.js lab that makes red-green-refactor evidence, literal acceptance, forward coverage, and the aggregate gate independently observable. The lab seeds one deliberate aggregate-gate failure after focused behavior is green, then requires the learner to diagnose the first failing subcheck and repair the governed evidence record without changing the test, gate, policy, or verifier.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Revalidate the pinned Directive 0.112.0 focused-check, literal-acceptance, forward-coverage, aggregate-check, and gate-integrity surfaces, recording any 0.114.0 authoring-runtime disagreement without teaching it as pinned behavior.
2. Author the Module 10 lesson, guarded lab, fictional fixture, and explained solution around a staged red-green-refactor cycle followed by an intentional aggregate-gate failure whose only valid repair is the incomplete work record.
3. Add focused verifier, negative, and fixture tests; update exact curriculum navigation and source records; then run the Module 10 checks, xBRIEF conformance, literal acceptance gate, and the separate aggregate repository gate.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer learning Directive, I want to separate focused tests, literal acceptance, forward coverage, and the aggregate gate, so that I can diagnose failures and repair the work without weakening the gate.
narratives.Traces: Parent training.modules9-11.gates; PROJECT-DEFINITION LearningGoals: proof-driven testing and aggregate checks; PROJECT-DEFINITION DirectiveBaseline, SupportedEnvironments, LabModel, DevelopmentPosture, and ProjectRules contracts
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance commands; do not weaken, rewrite, or embed that aggregate repository gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

narrative.Acceptance: The source and runtime record validates exact Directive 0.112.0 focused-check, literal-acceptance, forward-coverage, aggregate-check, and gate-integrity behavior with relevant exit signals, while labeling every newer-runtime disagreement or unexecuted platform accurately.

items.title: Build the guarded gate-lab starting state

narrative.Acceptance: The supplied helper rejects mutation unless the canonical root is its unique OS-temporary no-remote repository, branch training/module-10 is clean at the named checkpoint, the exact Directive 0.112.0 graph is installed, exactly one story is active/running, and stage-specific mutable paths never include the Taskfile, gate verifier, policy, package scripts, or framework deposit.

The learner adds one focused behavioral test, retains its expected assertion failure, implements only the authorized source behavior, reruns to green, refactors without changing behavior, and records each exit and diff checkpoint in order with the test frozen after the red checkpoint.

items.title: Diagnose and repair the seeded aggregate failure

narrative.Acceptance: After focused and literal acceptance checks pass, the aggregate lab gate fails for the seeded incomplete quality record; the learner identifies the first failing subcheck, updates only that governed work record from observed evidence, leaves gate-definition hashes unchanged, and reruns focused, literal, forward-coverage, and aggregate checks to green.

items.title: Verify the lesson, lab, recovery, and boundary

narrative.Acceptance: The focused negative-test verifier rejects a non-temporary or remote target, wrong branch or lifecycle state, altered exact pin, skipped or reordered red-green-refactor evidence, gate or verifier edits, incomplete quality evidence, broken links or outcome mappings, unsupported platform claims, and any claim that Module 11 is learner-ready in this scope.
